purpose: Named religious creation and cosmic-order accounts, their interpretation and living use, alongside clearly separated empirical cosmology questions.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.

Attribute sacred narratives and interpretive claims to their communities. Keep empirical cosmology tied to observations and model uncertainty; do not claim an ancient text predicted a modern result from a loose translation.
